# Zendesk — Zendesk for Startups

Free Zendesk Professional Suite and Copilot for up to 50 agents; baseline term is 6 months, with 1- or 2-year terms only for startups affiliated with Zendesk's institutional funding partners.

| **Category** | [💬 Customer Support](../categories/support.md) |

| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 6 months |
| **When it ends** | No credit card is required upfront, but when your trial ends, you'll need to choose a paid plan to keep using your Zendesk account. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline (no partner affiliation) | — | Once accepted, the baseline program length for all startups is 6 months. | No partner needed |
| Partner-affiliated (VC or accelerator) | — | Extended offers of 1 or 2 years are tied to specific institutional funding partnerships, such as our VC and accelerator partners. | A partner code is required |

### Notes

VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION on this same page. The hero disclaimer (more conservative, quoted here) says: "This offer is available only to new Zendesk customers who have received outside funding (Angel, Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, or Series B rounds) and who have (i) 250 or fewer employees if referred by one of our partners, or (ii) 50 or fewer employees if not referred by our partners." The FAQ instead says "Must have fewer than 250 employees", "If employee size 50-249, must be referred by a partner", and "Whether you are venture-backed, bootstrapped, or anywhere in between, we are committed to supporting founders at every stage of their journey." funding_required=true and open_to_bootstrapped=false follow the conservative disclaimer. IMPORTANT: employees_max=250 applies ONLY to partner-referred startups; without a partner referral the cap is 50 employees. FAQ also requires: "Must be a brand new Zendesk subscriber (previous or active paid customers may not participate)" and "Company must be under 10 years old". requires_vc_backing=false because the disclaimer explicitly accepts Angel rounds.
